slots.name: rules
slots.about: the rules in order: id (1 up), label, kind (length: min to max characters; any: has one of chars; none: has none of chars), min, max (0 unless length), chars (a list of single characters, [] for length); 1 or more

slots.name: count_line
slots.about: the quiet line under the rules once something is typed; may read met and total

slots.name: error_line
slots.about: the field's error after a try with rules unmet; may read met and total

slots.name: done_line
slots.about: the line once saved; may read kept

slots.name: set_draft
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: the field's typing (value: the text)

slots.name: next
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: saves when every rule is met, otherwise marks the unmet ones

slots.name: change
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: reopens the field with the saved text

empty.shows: every rule unmet in the quiet role with a cross, no count line, Next dimmed

attention.shows: unmet rules and their crosses turn to the warning role and the field says how many are met

fallback.shows: the form and Next give way to a check, the done line and Change

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops swap, rise and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: a met rule has a check and an unmet one a cross, the count line says how many are met, and the error says it in words
